title: Save Electricity at Home
subtitle: 考点：一般现在时 / unplug, quick shower

dialogue.t: Mike, why do you turn off the lights?
We use electricity to light our rooms, so I turn it off when I leave.
Good. What else do you do?
I unplug the TV when I don't watch it.
Do you use the air conditioner a lot?
No. I use it only when it is very hot.
I take a quick shower, not a long bath. Saving energy is easy.

vocab: electricity 电 · light 照亮/灯 · unplug 拔掉插头 · air conditioner 空调 · quick 快的 · shower 淋浴
